title: Slack has a size
hook: A completely booked hour has no space for an extra ten-minute task.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Recognise that spare calendar capacity is an explicit resource.

objective: Recognise that spare calendar capacity is an explicit resource.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A completely booked hour has no space for an extra ten-minute task. What can accommodate an unplanned 10-minute task here? Correct option: A free 10-minute interval. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
